description: A high-performance, modern .NET Standard 2.0 / .NET 9 smart enum library and drop-in replacement for legacy enumeration packages. Supports System.Text.Json, Native AOT and EF Core with backward-compatible APIs.
A DataAnnotations ValidationAttribute that validates a DTO property/parameter value against an Xibalbalabs.Enumeration smart enum.
A Dapper SqlMapper.TypeHandler that maps Xibalbalabs.Enumeration smart enums to/from their underlying value.
ValueConverter implementations that map Xibalbalabs.Enumeration smart enums to/from their underlying value or display name for Entity Framework Core.
System.Text.Json converters for Xibalbalabs.Enumeration smart enums, with Native AOT support.

Controls for Avalonia for writing and reading messages in markdown, such as in an AI chat: MarkdownEditor, a WYSIWYG markdown editor that switches quickly between the markdown's source and the markdown rendered, and MarkdownView, which shows markdown to be read and copies what is selected in it as…
